passages.text: In the seventh year, on the tenth day of the fifth month, some of the elders of Israel came to inquire of the LORD, and they sat down before me.
passages.sermon:
This event happened in the seventh year.
It was the tenth day of the fifth month.
Some men came.
These men were elders of Israel.
They wanted to inquire of the LORD.
They sat down in front of me.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֣י׀ בַּשָּׁנָ֣ה הַשְּׁבִיעִ֗ית בַּֽחֲמִשִׁי֙ בֶּעָשׂ֣וֹר לַחֹ֔דֶשׁ בָּ֧אוּ אֲנָשִׁ֛ים מִזִּקְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לִדְרֹ֣שׁ אֶת־ יְהוָ֑ה וַיֵּשְׁב֖וּ לְפָנָֽי׃ס

passages.text: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying, “Son of man, speak to the elders of Israel and tell them that this is what the Lord GOD says: Have you come to inquire of Me? As surely as I live, I will not be consulted by you, declares the Lord GOD.
passages.sermon:
The word of the LORD came to me.
God spoke to me.
He called me "son of man."
He told me to speak to the elders of Israel.
He told me to say to them, "This is what the Lord GOD says."
God asked them, "Have you come to inquire of Me?"
God said, "As surely as I live, I will not be consulted by you."
The Lord GOD declared this.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃ בֶּן־ אָדָ֗ם דַּבֵּ֞ר אֶת־ זִקְנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵהֶ֔ם כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה הֲלִדְרֹ֥שׁ אֹתִ֖י אַתֶּ֣ם בָּאִ֑ים חַי־ אָ֙נִי֙ אִם־ אִדָּרֵ֣שׁ לָכֶ֔ם נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃

passages.text: Will you judge them, will you judge them, son of man? Confront them with the abominations of their fathers and tell them that this is what the Lord GOD says: On the day I chose Israel, I swore an oath to the descendants of the house of Jacob and made Myself known to them in the land of Egypt. With an uplifted hand I said to them, ‘I am the LORD your God.’
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Ezekiel.
God called Ezekiel "son of man."
God told Ezekiel to judge the elders of Israel.
God told Ezekiel to confront the elders.
God told Ezekiel to show them the sins of their fathers.
God told Ezekiel to speak to the elders.
God told Ezekiel to say, "This is what the Lord GOD says."
God said He chose Israel on a certain day.
God said He swore an oath to the descendants of Jacob.
God said He made Himself known to them in Egypt.
God said He raised His hand and declared, "I am the LORD your God."
passages.original: הֲתִשְׁפֹּ֣ט אֹתָ֔ם הֲתִשְׁפּ֖וֹט בֶּן־ אָדָ֑ם אֶת־ תּוֹעֲבֹ֥ת אֲבוֹתָ֖ם הוֹדִיעֵֽם׃ וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵיהֶ֗ם כֹּֽה־ אָמַר֮ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִה֒ בְּיוֹם֙ בָּחֳרִ֣י בְיִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וָאֶשָּׂ֣א יָדִ֗י לְזֶ֙רַע֙ בֵּ֣ית יַֽעֲקֹ֔ב וָאִוָּדַ֥ע לָהֶ֖ם בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם וָאֶשָּׂ֨א יָדִ֤י לָהֶם֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר אֲנִ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃

passages.text: On that day I swore to bring them out of the land of Egypt into a land that I had searched out for them, a land flowing with milk and honey, the glory of all lands.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Ezekiel.
God told Ezekiel about the people of Israel.
God chose the people of Israel.
God made a promise to them on that day.
God raised His hand and swore an oath.
God promised to bring the people of Israel out of Egypt.
God chose a land for them.
God searched out this land for the people of Israel.
This land flows with milk and honey.
This land is beautiful.
This land is the best of all lands.
passages.original: בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא נָשָׂ֤אתִי יָדִי֙ לָהֶ֔ם לְהֽוֹצִיאָ֖ם מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם אֶל־ אֶ֜רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־ תַּ֣רְתִּי לָהֶ֗ם זָבַ֤ת חָלָב֙ וּדְבַ֔שׁ צְבִ֥י הִ֖יא לְכָל־ הָאֲרָצֽוֹת׃

passages.text: And I said to them: ‘Each of you must throw away the abominations before his eyes, and you must not defile yourselves with the idols of Egypt. I am the LORD your God.’
passages.sermon:
God spoke to the people of Israel.
God told them what to do.
God said, "Each of you must throw away the abominations you see."
God commanded, "Do not make yourselves unclean with the idols of Egypt."
God declared, "I am the LORD your God."
passages.original: וָאֹמַ֣ר אֲלֵהֶ֗ם אִ֣ישׁ שִׁקּוּצֵ֤י עֵינָיו֙ הַשְׁלִ֔יכוּ וּבְגִלּוּלֵ֥י מִצְרַ֖יִם אַל־ תִּטַּמָּ֑אוּ אֲנִ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃

passages.text: But they rebelled against Me and refused to listen. None of them cast away the abominations before their eyes, and they did not forsake the idols of Egypt. So I resolved to pour out My wrath upon them and vent My anger against them in the land of Egypt.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites lived in Egypt.
God spoke to the Israelites.
God told them to throw away the abominations they saw.
God told them not to defile themselves with the idols of Egypt.
The Israelites rebelled against God.
They refused to listen to God.
No one threw away the abominations before their eyes.
They did not leave the idols of Egypt.
God decided to pour out His wrath on them.
God resolved to vent His anger against them in the land of Egypt.
passages.original: וַיַּמְרוּ־ בִ֗י וְלֹ֤א אָבוּ֙ לִּשְׁמֹ֣עַ אֵלַ֔י אִ֣ישׁ אֶת־ שִׁקּוּצֵ֤י עֵֽינֵיהֶם֙ לֹ֣א הִשְׁלִ֔יכוּ וְאֶת־ גִּלּוּלֵ֥י מִצְרַ֖יִם לֹ֣א עָזָ֑בוּ וָאֹמַ֞ר לִשְׁפֹּ֧ךְ חֲמָתִ֣י עֲלֵיהֶ֗ם לְכַלּ֤וֹת אַפִּי֙ בָּהֶ֔ם בְּת֖וֹךְ אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃

passages.text: But I acted for the sake of My name, that it should not be profaned in the eyes of the nations among whom they were living, in whose sight I had revealed Myself to Israel by bringing them out of the land of Egypt.
passages.sermon:
God is the LORD.
God revealed Himself to Israel.
God brought Israel out of the land of Egypt.
Israel lived among other nations.
God acted for the sake of His name.
God did not allow His name to be profaned.
God did this in the sight of the nations.
passages.original: וָאַ֙עַשׂ֙ לְמַ֣עַן שְׁמִ֔י לְבִלְתִּ֥י הֵחֵ֛ל לְעֵינֵ֥י הַגּוֹיִ֖ם אֲשֶׁר־ הֵ֣מָּה בְתוֹכָ֑ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר נוֹדַ֤עְתִּי אֲלֵיהֶם֙ לְעֵ֣ינֵיהֶ֔ם לְהוֹצִיאָ֖ם מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃

passages.text: So I brought them out of the land of Egypt and led them into the wilderness.
passages.sermon: God brought the people of Israel out of the land of Egypt.\r\nGod led the people of Israel into the wilderness.\r\n
passages.original: וָאֽוֹצִיאֵ֖ם מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם וָאֲבִאֵ֖ם אֶל־ הַמִּדְבָּֽר׃

passages.text: And I gave them My statutes and made known to them My ordinances—for the man who does these things will live by them.
passages.sermon: God gave Israel His statutes.\r\nGod made His ordinances known to Israel.\r\nA person who does these statutes and ordinances will live by them.
passages.original: וָאֶתֵּ֤ן לָהֶם֙ אֶת־ חֻקּוֹתַ֔י וְאֶת־ מִשְׁפָּטַ֖י הוֹדַ֣עְתִּי אוֹתָ֑ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר יַעֲשֶׂ֥ה אוֹתָ֛ם הָאָדָ֖ם וָחַ֥י בָּהֶֽם׃

passages.text: I also gave them My Sabbaths as a sign between us, so that they would know that I am the LORD who sanctifies them.
passages.sermon:
God is the LORD.
God sanctifies His people.
God gave the Israelites His Sabbaths.
God made the Sabbaths a sign.
The sign was between God and the Israelites.
God wanted the Israelites to know Him.
God wanted them to know He is the LORD who makes them holy.
passages.original: וְגַ֤ם אֶת־ שַׁבְּתוֹתַי֙ נָתַ֣תִּי לָהֶ֔ם לִהְי֣וֹת לְא֔וֹת בֵּינִ֖י וּבֵֽינֵיהֶ֑ם לָדַ֕עַת כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה מְקַדְּשָֽׁם׃

passages.text: Yet the house of Israel rebelled against Me in the wilderness. They did not follow My statutes and they rejected My ordinances—though the man who does these things will live by them—and they utterly profaned My Sabbaths. Then I resolved to pour out My wrath upon them and put an end to them in the wilderness.
passages.sermon:
The house of Israel rebelled against Me in the wilderness.
They did not follow My statutes.
They rejected My ordinances.
A person who does My ordinances will live by them.
They completely profaned My Sabbaths.
I decided to pour out My wrath on them in the wilderness.
I resolved to put an end to them there.
passages.original: וַיַּמְרוּ־ בִ֨י בֵֽית־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל בַּמִּדְבָּ֗ר בְּחֻקּוֹתַ֨י לֹא־ הָלָ֜כוּ וְאֶת־ מִשְׁפָּטַ֣י מָאָ֗סוּ אֲשֶׁר֩ יַעֲשֶׂ֨ה אֹתָ֤ם הָֽאָדָם֙ וָחַ֣י בָּהֶ֔ם וְאֶת־ שַׁבְּתֹתַ֖י חִלְּל֣וּ מְאֹ֑ד וָאֹמַ֞ר לִשְׁפֹּ֨ךְ חֲמָתִ֧י עֲלֵיהֶ֛ם בַּמִּדְבָּ֖ר לְכַלּוֹתָֽם׃

passages.text: But I acted for the sake of My name, so that it would not be profaned in the eyes of the nations in whose sight I had brought them out.
passages.sermon:
God brought Israel out of Egypt.
God acted for the sake of His name.
God did not let His name be dishonored.
God did this in front of the nations.
The nations saw God bring Israel out.
God wanted the nations to respect His name.
passages.original: וָאֶעֱשֶׂ֖ה לְמַ֣עַן שְׁמִ֑י לְבִלְתִּ֤י הֵחֵל֙ לְעֵינֵ֣י הַגּוֹיִ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר הוֹצֵאתִ֖ים לְעֵינֵיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: Moreover, with an uplifted hand I swore to them in the wilderness that I would not bring them into the land that I had given them—a land flowing with milk and honey, the glory of all lands— because they kept rejecting My ordinances, refusing to walk in My statutes, and profaning My Sabbaths; for their hearts continually went after their idols.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to the people of Israel in the wilderness.
God lifted His hand and swore an oath to them.
God said He would not bring them into the land He had promised.
This land was a land flowing with milk and honey.
This land was the most beautiful of all lands.
God made this decision because the people rejected His ordinances.
They refused to walk in His statutes.
They profaned His Sabbaths.
Their hearts always went after their idols.
passages.original: וְגַם־ אֲנִ֗י נָשָׂ֧אתִי יָדִ֛י לָהֶ֖ם בַּמִּדְבָּ֑ר לְבִלְתִּי֩ הָבִ֨יא אוֹתָ֜ם אֶל־ הָאָ֣רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־ נָתַ֗תִּי זָבַ֤ת חָלָב֙ וּדְבַ֔שׁ צְבִ֥י הִ֖יא לְכָל־ הָאֲרָצֽוֹת׃ יַ֜עַן בְּמִשְׁפָּטַ֣י מָאָ֗סוּ וְאֶת־ חֻקּוֹתַי֙ לֹא־ הָלְכ֣וּ בָהֶ֔ם וְאֶת־ שַׁבְּתוֹתַ֖י חִלֵּ֑לוּ כִּ֛י אַחֲרֵ֥י גִלּוּלֵיהֶ֖ם לִבָּ֥ם הֹלֵֽךְ׃

passages.text: Yet I looked on them with pity and did not destroy them or bring them to an end in the wilderness.
passages.sermon:
God looked at the people of Israel in the wilderness.
God felt pity for them.
God did not destroy them.
God did not bring them to an end in the wilderness.
passages.original: וַתָּ֧חָס עֵינִ֛י עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם מִֽשַּׁחֲתָ֑ם וְלֹֽא־ עָשִׂ֧יתִי אוֹתָ֛ם כָּלָ֖ה בַּמִּדְבָּֽר׃

passages.text: In the wilderness I said to their children: ‘Do not walk in the statutes of your fathers or keep their ordinances or defile yourselves with their idols.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to the children of Israel in the wilderness.
God told them not to follow the statutes of their fathers.
God told them not to keep the ordinances of their fathers.
God told them not to defile themselves with the idols of their fathers.
passages.original: וָאֹמַ֤ר אֶל־ בְּנֵיהֶם֙ בַּמִּדְבָּ֔ר בְּחוּקֵּ֤י אֲבֽוֹתֵיכֶם֙ אַל־ תֵּלֵ֔כוּ וְאֶת־ מִשְׁפְּטֵיהֶ֖ם אַל־ תִּשְׁמֹ֑רוּ וּבְגִלּוּלֵיהֶ֖ם אַל־ תִּטַּמָּֽאוּ׃

passages.text: I am the LORD your God; walk in My statutes, keep My ordinances, and practice them.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
He speaks to the people of Israel.
He commands them clearly.
He says, "Walk in My statutes."
He says, "Keep My ordinances."
He says, "Practice My commandments."
He gives these instructions directly.
He wants His people to obey Him.
He wants them to follow His ways.
passages.original: אֲנִי֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֔ם בְּחֻקּוֹתַ֖י לֵ֑כוּ וְאֶת־ מִשְׁפָּטַ֥י שִׁמְר֖וּ וַעֲשׂ֥וּ אוֹתָֽם׃

passages.text: Keep My Sabbaths holy, that they may be a sign between us, so that you may know that I am the LORD your God.’
passages.sermon:
God spoke to the Israelites in the wilderness.
God is the LORD their God.
God commanded the Israelites to keep His Sabbaths holy.
The Sabbaths are special days set apart by God.
The Sabbaths are a sign between God and the Israelites.
This sign shows that God is the LORD their God.
By keeping the Sabbaths holy, the Israelites know that God is their LORD.
passages.original: וְאֶת־ שַׁבְּתוֹתַ֖י קַדֵּ֑שׁוּ וְהָי֤וּ לְאוֹת֙ בֵּינִ֣י וּבֵֽינֵיכֶ֔ם לָדַ֕עַת כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃

passages.text: But the children rebelled against Me. They did not walk in My statutes or carefully observe My ordinances—though the man who does these things will live by them—and they profaned My Sabbaths. So I resolved to pour out My wrath upon them and vent My anger against them in the wilderness.
passages.sermon:
The children of Israel rebelled against Me.
They did not follow My statutes.
They did not keep My ordinances.
Anyone who does My ordinances will live by them.
They profaned My Sabbaths.
I decided to pour out My wrath on them.
I resolved to spend My anger on them in the wilderness.
passages.original: וַיַּמְרוּ־ בִ֣י הַבָּנִ֗ים בְּחֻקּוֹתַ֣י לֹֽא־ הָ֠לָכוּ וְאֶת־ מִשְׁפָּטַ֨י לֹא־ שָׁמְר֜וּ לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת אוֹתָ֗ם אֲשֶׁר֩ יַעֲשֶׂ֨ה אוֹתָ֤ם הָֽאָדָם֙ וָחַ֣י בָּהֶ֔ם אֶת־ שַׁבְּתוֹתַ֖י חִלֵּ֑לוּ וָאֹמַ֞ר לִשְׁפֹּ֧ךְ חֲמָתִ֣י עֲלֵיהֶ֗ם לְכַלּ֥וֹת אַפִּ֛י בָּ֖ם בַּמִּדְבָּֽר׃

passages.text: But I withheld My hand and acted for the sake of My name, so that it would not be profaned in the eyes of the nations in whose sight I had brought them out.
passages.sermon:
God is the LORD.
God brought the Israelites out of Egypt.
God did this in front of many nations.
The Israelites rebelled against God in the wilderness.
God decided not to destroy them completely.
God held back His hand.
God acted to protect His own name.
God did this so the nations would not dishonor His name.
God wanted His name to remain holy in the eyes of the nations.
passages.original: וַהֲשִׁבֹ֙תִי֙ אֶת־ יָדִ֔י וָאַ֖עַשׂ לְמַ֣עַן שְׁמִ֑י לְבִלְתִּ֤י הֵחֵל֙ לְעֵינֵ֣י הַגּוֹיִ֔ם אֲשֶׁר־ הוֹצֵ֥אתִי אוֹתָ֖ם לְעֵינֵיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: However, with an uplifted hand I swore to them in the wilderness that I would scatter them among the nations and disperse them throughout the lands.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to the Israelites in the wilderness.
God lifted His hand and made a solemn oath to them.
God promised to scatter the Israelites among the nations.
God said He would disperse them throughout many lands.
passages.original: גַּם־ אֲנִ֗י נָשָׂ֧אתִי אֶת־ יָדִ֛י לָהֶ֖ם בַּמִּדְבָּ֑ר לְהָפִ֤יץ אֹתָם֙ בַּגּוֹיִ֔ם וּלְזָר֥וֹת אוֹתָ֖ם בָּאֲרָצֽוֹת׃

passages.text: For they did not practice My ordinances, but they rejected My statutes and profaned My Sabbaths, fixing their eyes on the idols of their fathers.
passages.sermon:
The people of Israel did not obey God's ordinances.
They rejected God's statutes.
They profaned God's Sabbaths.
They looked to the idols of their fathers.
passages.original: יַ֜עַן מִשְׁפָּטַ֤י לֹֽא־ עָשׂוּ֙ וְחֻקּוֹתַ֣י מָאָ֔סוּ וְאֶת־ שַׁבְּתוֹתַ֖י חִלֵּ֑לוּ וְאַחֲרֵי֙ גִּלּוּלֵ֣י אֲבוֹתָ֔ם הָי֖וּ עֵינֵיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: I also gave them over to statutes that were not good and ordinances by which they could not live.
passages.sermon:
God is the Lord.
God gave laws to the people of Israel.
These laws were not good.
God gave them rules that could not bring life.
God let them follow these harmful statutes.
God did this as a consequence for their disobedience.
passages.original: וְגַם־ אֲנִי֙ נָתַ֣תִּי לָהֶ֔ם חֻקִּ֖ים לֹ֣א טוֹבִ֑ים וּמִ֨שְׁפָּטִ֔ים לֹ֥א יִֽחְי֖וּ בָּהֶֽם׃

passages.text: And I pronounced them unclean through their gifts—the sacrifice of every firstborn in the fire—so that I might devastate them, in order that they would know that I am the LORD.
passages.sermon:
God is the LORD.
God spoke about the people of Israel.
God made them unclean through their gifts.
They offered every firstborn as a sacrifice in the fire.
God allowed this to happen to devastate them.
God did this so they would know that He is the LORD.
passages.original: וָאֲטַמֵּ֤א אוֹתָם֙ בְּמַתְּנוֹתָ֔ם בְּהַעֲבִ֖יר כָּל־ פֶּ֣טֶר רָ֑חַם לְמַ֣עַן אֲשִׁמֵּ֔ם לְמַ֙עַן֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יֵֽדְע֔וּ אֲשֶׁ֖ר אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃ס

passages.text: Therefore, son of man, speak to the house of Israel, and tell them that this is what the Lord GOD says: In this way also your fathers blasphemed Me by their unfaithfulness against Me.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Ezekiel.
God called Ezekiel "son of man."
God told Ezekiel to speak to the house of Israel.
God told Ezekiel to say, "This is what the Lord GOD says."
God said, "Your fathers blasphemed Me."
God said, "They acted unfaithfully against Me."
God said, "They did this in another way also."
passages.original: לָכֵ֞ן דַּבֵּ֨ר אֶל־ בֵּ֤ית יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ בֶּן־ אָדָ֔ם וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵיהֶ֔ם כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֑ה ע֗וֹד זֹ֚את גִּדְּפ֤וּ אוֹתִי֙ אֲב֣וֹתֵיכֶ֔ם בְּמַעֲלָ֥ם בִּ֖י מָֽעַל׃

passages.text: When I brought them into the land that I swore to give them and they saw any high hill or leafy tree, there they offered their sacrifices, presented offerings that provoked Me, sent up their fragrant incense, and poured out their drink offerings.
passages.sermon:
God brought the people of Israel into the land.
God had sworn to give this land to them.
The people saw every high hill.
They saw every leafy tree.
They offered their sacrifices there.
They presented offerings there that made God angry.
They burned incense there for a pleasing smell.
They poured out their drink offerings there.
passages.original: וָאֲבִיאֵם֙ אֶל־ הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֤ר נָשָׂ֙אתִי֙ אֶת־ יָדִ֔י לָתֵ֥ת אוֹתָ֖הּ לָהֶ֑ם וַיִּרְאוּ֩ כָל־ גִּבְעָ֨ה רָמָ֜ה וְכָל־ עֵ֣ץ עָבֹ֗ת וַיִּזְבְּחוּ־ שָׁ֤ם אֶת־ זִבְחֵיהֶם֙ וַיִּתְּנוּ־ שָׁם֙ כַּ֣עַס קָרְבָּנָ֔ם וַיָּשִׂ֣ימוּ שָׁ֗ם רֵ֚יחַ נִיח֣וֹחֵיהֶ֔ם וַיַּסִּ֥יכוּ שָׁ֖ם אֶת־ נִסְכֵּיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: So I asked them: ‘What is this high place to which you go?’ (And to this day it is called Bamah.)
passages.sermon:
God spoke to the people of Israel.
God asked them a question.
God said, “What is this high place?”
God asked, “Why do you go there?”
The people called that place Bamah.
That place is still called Bamah today.
passages.original: וָאֹמַ֣ר אֲלֵהֶ֔ם מָ֣ה הַבָּמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־ אַתֶּ֥ם הַבָּאִ֖ים שָׁ֑ם וַיִּקָּרֵ֤א שְׁמָהּ֙ בָּמָ֔ה עַ֖ד הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃

passages.text: Therefore tell the house of Israel that this is what the Lord GOD says: Will you defile yourselves the way your fathers did, prostituting yourselves with their abominations?
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks to the house of Israel.
He says, "You defile yourselves as your fathers did."
You follow the same corrupt ways as your ancestors.
You act with impurity.
You chase after their abominations.
You turn away from Me.
You give yourselves to idols and evil practices.
passages.original: לָכֵ֞ן אֱמֹ֣ר׀ אֶל־ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה הַבְּדֶ֥רֶךְ אֲבֽוֹתֵיכֶ֖ם אַתֶּ֣ם נִטְמְאִ֑ים וְאַחֲרֵ֥י שִׁקּוּצֵיהֶ֖ם אַתֶּ֥ם זֹנִֽים׃

passages.text: When you offer your gifts, sacrificing your sons in the fire, you continue to defile yourselves with all your idols to this day. So should I be consulted by you, O house of Israel? As surely as I live, declares the Lord GOD, I will not be consulted by you!
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks to the house of Israel.
You offer your gifts.
You sacrifice your sons in the fire.
You defile yourselves with all your idols.
You do this even to this day.
You ask Me to answer you.
I am the Lord GOD.
As surely as I live, I will not answer you.
I will not be consulted by you.
passages.original: וּבִשְׂאֵ֣ת מַתְּנֹֽתֵיכֶ֡ם בְּֽהַעֲבִיר֩ בְּנֵיכֶ֨ם בָּאֵ֜שׁ אַתֶּם֩ נִטְמְאִ֤֨ים לְכָל־ גִּלּֽוּלֵיכֶם֙ עַד־ הַיּ֔וֹם וַאֲנִ֛י אִדָּרֵ֥שׁ לָכֶ֖ם בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל חַי־ אָ֗נִי נְאֻם֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה אִם־ אִדָּרֵ֖שׁ לָכֶֽם׃

passages.text: When you say, ‘Let us be like the nations, like the peoples of the lands, serving wood and stone,’ what you have in mind will never come to pass.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to the house of Israel.
God knows what you are thinking.
You say, "Let us be like the nations."
You say, "Let us be like the peoples of the lands."
You want to serve idols made of wood and stone.
God says this will never happen.
What you plan will not come to pass.
passages.original: וְהָֽעֹלָה֙ עַל־ ר֣וּחֲכֶ֔ם הָי֖וֹ לֹ֣א תִֽהְיֶ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר׀ אַתֶּ֣ם אֹמְרִ֗ים נִֽהְיֶ֤ה כַגּוֹיִם֙ כְּמִשְׁפְּח֣וֹת הָאֲרָצ֔וֹת לְשָׁרֵ֖ת עֵ֥ץ וָאָֽבֶן׃

passages.text: As surely as I live, declares the Lord GOD, with a strong hand, an outstretched arm, and outpoured wrath I will rule over you.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks to the house of Israel.
The Lord GOD is alive.
The Lord GOD makes a solemn declaration.
The Lord GOD says, "I will rule over you."
The Lord GOD will use a strong hand.
The Lord GOD will use an outstretched arm.
The Lord GOD will pour out His wrath.
The Lord GOD will rule over Israel with power and anger.
passages.original: חַי־ אָ֕נִי נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֑ה אִם־ לֹ֠א בְּיָ֨ד חֲזָקָ֜ה וּבִזְר֧וֹעַ נְטוּיָ֛ה וּבְחֵמָ֥ה שְׁפוּכָ֖ה אֶמְל֥וֹךְ עֲלֵיכֶֽם׃

passages.text: With a strong hand, an outstretched arm, and outpoured wrath I will bring you out from the peoples and gather you from the lands to which you have been scattered.
passages.sermon:
The Lord God speaks to Israel.
He says, “I will act with power.
I will use a strong hand.
I will stretch out my arm.
I will show my anger.
I will bring you out from among the peoples.
You are scattered in many lands.
I will gather you from those lands.
I will do this with strength and wrath.”
passages.original: וְהוֹצֵאתִ֤י אֶתְכֶם֙ מִן־ הָ֣עַמִּ֔ים וְקִבַּצְתִּ֣י אֶתְכֶ֔ם מִן־ הָ֣אֲרָצ֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר נְפוֹצֹתֶ֖ם בָּ֑ם בְּיָ֤ד חֲזָקָה֙ וּבִזְר֣וֹעַ נְטוּיָ֔ה וּבְחֵמָ֖ה שְׁפוּכָֽה׃

passages.text: And I will bring you into the wilderness of the nations, where I will enter into judgment with you face to face.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks to the people of Israel.
He is powerful and rules over all nations.
He will bring the people of Israel out from among the nations.
He will lead them into the wilderness of the nations.
He will meet them there.
He will judge them there.
He will judge them face to face.
passages.original: וְהֵבֵאתִ֣י אֶתְכֶ֔ם אֶל־ מִדְבַּ֖ר הָֽעַמִּ֑ים וְנִשְׁפַּטְתִּ֤י אִתְּכֶם֙ שָׁ֔ם פָּנִ֖ים אֶל־ פָּנִֽים׃

passages.text: Just as I entered into judgment with your fathers in the wilderness of the land of Egypt, so I will enter into judgment with you, declares the Lord GOD.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks.
He is the one who judges.
He judged your fathers long ago.
He judged them in the wilderness.
This wilderness was in the land of Egypt.
In the same way, He will judge you.
The Lord GOD declares this.
passages.original: כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר נִשְׁפַּ֙טְתִּי֙ אֶת־ אֲב֣וֹתֵיכֶ֔ם בְּמִדְבַּ֖ר אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם כֵּ֚ן אִשָּׁפֵ֣ט אִתְּכֶ֔ם נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃

passages.text: I will make you pass under the rod and will bring you into the bond of the covenant.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to the people of Israel.
God says, “I will make you pass under the rod.”
I will examine you carefully.
I will count you as a shepherd counts his sheep.
I will bring you into the bond of the covenant.
I will restore you to My promise and agreement.
passages.original: וְהַעֲבַרְתִּ֥י אֶתְכֶ֖ם תַּ֣חַת הַשָּׁ֑בֶט וְהֵבֵאתִ֥י אֶתְכֶ֖ם בְּמָסֹ֥רֶת הַבְּרִֽית׃

passages.text: And I will purge you of those who rebel and transgress against Me. I will bring them out of the land in which they dwell, but they will not enter the land of Israel. Then you will know that I am the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks to the house of Israel.
The Lord will remove from among you all who rebel against Him.
The Lord will remove from among you all who sin against Him.
The Lord will bring these rebels out from the land where they now live.
The Lord will not allow these rebels to enter the land of Israel.
You will know that the Lord is God.
passages.original: וּבָרוֹתִ֣י מִכֶּ֗ם הַמֹּרְדִ֤ים וְהַפּֽוֹשְׁעִים֙ בִּ֔י מֵאֶ֤רֶץ מְגֽוּרֵיהֶם֙ אוֹצִ֣יא אוֹתָ֔ם וְאֶל־ אַדְמַ֥ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֹ֣א יָב֑וֹא וִֽידַעְתֶּ֖ם כִּי־ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: And as for you, O house of Israel, this is what the Lord GOD says: Go and serve your idols, every one of you. But afterward, you will surely listen to Me, and you will no longer defile My holy name with your gifts and idols.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks to the house of Israel.
He says, “Each of you, go and serve your idols.”
You have chosen to worship false gods.
But later, you will listen to Me.
You will stop defiling My holy name.
You will not dishonor My name with your gifts.
You will not dishonor My name with your idols.
passages.original: וְאַתֶּ֨ם בֵּֽית־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֣ר׀ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהֹוִ֗ה אִ֤ישׁ גִּלּוּלָיו֙ לְכ֣וּ עֲבֹ֔דוּ וְאַחַ֕ר אִם־ אֵינְכֶ֖ם שֹׁמְעִ֣ים אֵלָ֑י וְאֶת־ שֵׁ֤ם קָדְשִׁי֙ לֹ֣א תְחַלְּלוּ־ ע֔וֹד בְּמַתְּנֽוֹתֵיכֶ֖ם וּבְגִלּוּלֵיכֶֽם׃

passages.text: For on My holy mountain, the high mountain of Israel, declares the Lord GOD, there the whole house of Israel, all of them, will serve Me in the land. There I will accept them and will require your offerings and choice gifts, along with all your holy sacrifices.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks.
He says, "My holy mountain stands in Israel."
This mountain is the high mountain of Israel.
All the people of Israel will serve Me there.
They will serve Me in the land.
I will accept them there.
I will require your offerings there.
I will require your best gifts there.
I will require all your holy sacrifices there.
passages.original: כִּ֣י בְהַר־ קָדְשִׁ֞י בְּהַ֣ר׀ מְר֣וֹם יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל נְאֻם֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה שָׁ֣ם יַעַבְדֻ֜נִי כָּל־ בֵּ֧ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל כֻּלֹּ֖ה בָּאָ֑רֶץ שָׁ֣ם אֶרְצֵ֔ם וְשָׁ֞ם אֶדְר֣וֹשׁ אֶת־ תְּרוּמֹֽתֵיכֶ֗ם וְאֶת־ רֵאשִׁ֛ית מַשְׂאוֹתֵיכֶ֖ם בְּכָל־ קָדְשֵׁיכֶֽם׃

passages.text: When I bring you from the peoples and gather you from the lands to which you have been scattered, I will accept you as a pleasing aroma. And I will show My holiness through you in the sight of the nations.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks to the house of Israel.
God scattered Israel among many nations.
God will bring Israel out from those nations.
God will gather Israel from all the lands where they were scattered.
God will accept Israel as a pleasing aroma.
God will show His holiness through Israel.
God will do this in the sight of all the nations.
passages.original: בְּרֵ֣יחַ נִיחֹחַ֮ אֶרְצֶ֣ה אֶתְכֶם֒ בְּהוֹצִיאִ֤י אֶתְכֶם֙ מִן־ הָ֣עַמִּ֔ים וְקִבַּצְתִּ֣י אֶתְכֶ֔ם מִן־ הָ֣אֲרָצ֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר נְפֹצֹתֶ֖ם בָּ֑ם וְנִקְדַּשְׁתִּ֥י בָכֶ֖ם לְעֵינֵ֥י הַגּוֹיִֽם׃

passages.text: Then you will know that I am the LORD, when I bring you into the land of Israel, the land that I swore to give your fathers.
passages.sermon:
The Lord is speaking to the people of Israel.
The Lord promised to give a land to the ancestors of Israel.
The Lord will bring the people of Israel into this land.
When the Lord does this, the people will know that He is the Lord.
passages.original: וִֽידַעְתֶּם֙ כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֔ה בַּהֲבִיאִ֥י אֶתְכֶ֖ם אֶל־ אַדְמַ֣ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אֶל־ הָאָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֤ר נָשָׂ֙אתִי֙ אֶת־ יָדִ֔י לָתֵ֥ת אוֹתָ֖הּ לַאֲבֽוֹתֵיכֶֽם׃

passages.text: There you will remember your ways and all the deeds with which you have defiled yourselves, and you will loathe yourselves for all the evils you have done.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to the people of Israel.
God had scattered them among many nations because of their sins.
God promised to bring them back to their own land.
When they return, they will remember their ways.
They will remember all their deeds.
They will see how they defiled themselves by their actions.
They will feel disgusted with themselves.
They will hate all the evil things they have done.
passages.original: וּזְכַרְתֶּם־ שָׁ֗ם אֶת־ דַּרְכֵיכֶם֙ וְאֵת֙ כָּל־ עֲלִיל֣וֹתֵיכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִטְמֵאתֶ֖ם בָּ֑ם וּנְקֹֽטֹתֶם֙ בִּפְנֵיכֶ֔ם בְּכָל־ רָעוֹתֵיכֶ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר עֲשִׂיתֶֽם׃

passages.text: Then you will know, O house of Israel, that I am the LORD, when I have dealt with you for the sake of My name and not according to your wicked ways and corrupt acts, declares the Lord GOD.”
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks to the house of Israel.
He says, "You will know that I am the LORD.
I will act with you for the sake of My name.
I will not act with you according to your evil ways.
I will not act with you according to your corrupt deeds.
I, the Lord GOD, declare this."
passages.original: וִֽידַעְתֶּם֙ כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֔ה בַּעֲשׂוֹתִ֥י אִתְּכֶ֖ם לְמַ֣עַן שְׁמִ֑י לֹא֩ כְדַרְכֵיכֶ֨ם הָרָעִ֜ים וְכַעֲלִילֽוֹתֵיכֶ֤ם הַנִּשְׁחָתוֹת֙ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃פ

passages.text: Now the word of the LORD came to me, saying, “Son of man, set your face toward the south, preach against it, and prophesy against the forest of the Negev.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to me.
He gave me a message.
He called me “son of man.”
He told me to look toward the south.
He told me to speak against the south.
He told me to prophesy against the forest in the Negev.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃ בֶּן־ אָדָ֗ם שִׂ֤ים פָּנֶ֙יךָ֙ דֶּ֣רֶךְ תֵּימָ֔נָה וְהַטֵּ֖ף אֶל־ דָּר֑וֹם וְהִנָּבֵ֛א אֶל־ יַ֥עַר הַשָּׂדֶ֖ה נֶֽגֶב׃

passages.text: Say to the forest of the Negev: Hear the word of the LORD! This is what the Lord GOD says: I am about to ignite in you a fire, and it will devour all your trees, both green and dry. The blazing flame will not be quenched, and by it every face from south to north will be scorched.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD spoke to Ezekiel.
Ezekiel was a prophet in Israel.
God told Ezekiel to speak to the forest in the Negev.
God said, "Hear the word of the LORD."
God said, "I am about to start a fire in you, forest of the Negev."
This fire will burn in you.
The fire will consume every tree in you.
It will burn both green trees and dry trees.
The fire will be a blazing flame.
No one will put out this flame.
The fire will scorch every face.
It will burn from the south to the north.
passages.original: וְאָֽמַרְתָּ֙ לְיַ֣עַר הַנֶּ֔גֶב שְׁמַ֖ע דְּבַר־ יְהוָ֑ה כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֣ר אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֡ה הִנְנִ֣י מַֽצִּית־ בְּךָ֣׀ אֵ֡שׁ וְאָכְלָ֣ה בְךָ֣ כָל־ עֵֽץ־ לַח֩ וְכָל־ עֵ֨ץ יָבֵ֤שׁ לֹֽא־ תִכְבֶּה֙ לַהֶ֣בֶת שַׁלְהֶ֔בֶת וְנִצְרְבוּ־ בָ֥הּ כָּל־ פָּנִ֖ים מִנֶּ֥גֶב צָפֽוֹנָה׃

passages.text: Then all people will see that I, the LORD, have kindled it; it will not be quenched.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD is speaking.
The LORD has kindled the fire.
All people will see this.
Everyone will know that the LORD started the fire.
No one can put out the fire.
passages.original: וְרָאוּ֙ כָּל־ בָּשָׂ֔ר כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה בִּֽעַרְתִּ֑יהָ לֹ֖א תִּכְבֶּֽה׃

passages.text: Then I said, “Ah, Lord GOD, they are saying of me, ‘Is he not just telling parables?’ ”
passages.sermon:
Ezekiel is a prophet.
Ezekiel speaks to the Lord GOD.
Ezekiel says, “Ah, Lord GOD.
The people are speaking about me.
They say to me, ‘Is he not just telling parables?’”
passages.original: וָאֹמַ֕ר אֲהָ֖הּ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֑ה הֵ֚מָּה אֹמְרִ֣ים לִ֔י הֲלֹ֛א מְמַשֵּׁ֥ל מְשָׁלִ֖ים הֽוּא׃פ
